textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 10 social-science · Geography 4: Agriculture · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Types of farming include primitive subsistence, intensive subsistence, and commercial farming, with plantation as a type of commercial farming.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Types of farming include primitive subsistence, intensive subsistence, and commercial farming, with plantation as a type of commercial farming.
beats.speakEn: Types of farming include primitive subsistence, intensive subsistence, and commercial farming, with plantation as a type of commercial farming.

beats.en: Primitive subsistence farming uses a hoe, dao and digging stick. In the north-east it is known as jhumming, or slash and burn.
beats.speakEn: Primitive subsistence farming uses a hoe, dao and digging stick. In the north-east it is known as jhumming, or slash and burn.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 10 social-science · Geography 4: Agriculture · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: In intensive subsistence farming, high pressure of population leads to using more labour on small land. Commercial farming uses higher doses of fertilisers and pesticides.

beats.en: In intensive subsistence farming, high pressure of population leads to using more labour on small land. Commercial farming uses higher doses of fertilisers and pesticides.
beats.speakEn: In intensive subsistence farming, high pressure of population leads to using more labour on small land. Commercial farming uses higher doses of fertilisers and pesticides.

beats.en: India has three cropping seasons. Rabi is sown in winter and harvested in summer, kharif is sown with the monsoon, and zaid is a short season between rabi and kharif.
beats.speakEn: India has three cropping seasons. Rabi is sown in winter and harvested in summer, kharif is sown with the monsoon, and zaid is a short season between rabi and kharif.
